// why: bun runs these files directly and needs no build step, so this config is
not a build config — it exists so the claim 'type-checks clean under strict'
can be reproduced by anyone, instead of being asserted. A handoff agent
could not reproduce it precisely because no config was committed.
bun add -d @types/bun typescript   # once, in this dir or any ancestor of it (repo root works)
bunx tsc --noEmit -p .             # expects: no output, exit 0
@types/bun is deliberately NOT vendored here: the skill ships zero
node_modules and installing them is the checker's job, not the skill's.
